$comment: THE FLOOR GATE baseline (cinatra#2931 W4, plan `PLAN: Agents Lifecycle (B)` §5). Every artifact type here is one whose review resolves through NO renderer today and therefore lands on the card's metadata floor. The gate requires the LIVE floor set to equal this file exactly: a type that newly lands on the floor fails, and a type that stops landing on it fails until its entry is deleted. The committed set may only shrink against the base branch. The plan names exactly these two as the work it defers: 'everything a review shows is an artifact, and its package's renderer renders it — a dashboard and content held in a third-party CMS included. How exactly those two packages store and render their work is decided outside this plan.' So the gate landed as 'no new fallbacks'. The dashboard converted (cinatra#4311). The Drupal page pointer stays by design: it is drawn as the generic floor and is never a review target, so the set ends at that one entry.

floorTypes.reason: The Drupal page pointer. It is drawn as the generic floor by design and is never a review target: a Drupal page under review is its page snapshot, drawn by the page display. The pack declares a connector-reference form resolving to text/html and ships no renderer for the pointer.

renames.reason: The Drupal pack moved its pointer type from the host-registered @cinatra-ai/drupal:node into its own namespace. Same pack, same connector-reference text/html form, same floor; one entry out, one in.
